allowed_scope.product: Only full snapshot dependency INSERT statements, using the existing snapshot-only flag and transaction.
not_changed: manifest payload/digest and payload byte rejection
transaction ownership, commit, rollback, epoch/CAS and rebuild swap

patch.execution: Not applied with git; all candidate source files are separately byte-exact Git blobs.

original_call_chain: All existing public/config/deferred/incremental entrypoints continue snapshot_leaf_batches=false or unchanged public_surface::insert_on / resolution_dependency_store::replace_on.
Full path now public_surface::insert_snapshot_on -> unchanged shared surface preparation/INSERT -> resolution_dependency_store::replace_snapshot_on.
replace_with preserves original clone -> normalize -> validate -> serialize -> payload bound -> DELETE dependencies -> INSERT OR REPLACE manifest -> dependency insertion.
Only normalized dependency cardinality>=8 and snapshot flagtrue select the new bounded dependency binder; smaller sets retain the original prepare_cached/execute loop.

implementation.buffer_adjustment: Accept IntoIterator<Item=&T> instead of only &[T], so a normalized BTreeSet is borrowed directly without collecting all dependency references. Existing slice callers, byte accounting, flush order and 64/64KiB constants retain their behavior.
implementation.oversize_legal_row: Original no-extra-rejection behavior: a single row larger than the batching byte bound is inserted alone.
implementation.bound_bytes: Actual repeated file_path UTF8 bytes + DependencyKind::as_str bytes + dependency.key UTF8 bytes through the existing payload_bytes helper; no serialized-size guess.
implementation.conflict_clause: Plain INSERT, unchanged. No OR IGNORE or OR REPLACE was added for dependency rows.
implementation.order: Borrow the normalized manifest BTreeSet in its exact existing order. Multi-VALUES preserves row order and no row is held across a file boundary.
implementation.cache: Reuse index_db_multi_insert::multi_insert; at most the existing three SQL arities for this table.

static_author_checks.interpretation: These are source/transport checks, not passing Rust tests or source admission.

new_controls.name: resolution_snapshot_batches_match_original_order_and_statement_work
new_controls.coverage: Compare original per-row SQL to new bounded helper at0/1/7/8/9/63/64/65/73/129/4096 inputs, all7 kinds, Unicode and duplicate-set insertion; compare actual rowid+allcolumns after every file; compare SQLite StatementStatus::Run rather than wall time.

new_controls.name: resolution_snapshot_byte_windows_keep_legal_large_rows_single
new_controls.coverage: 4096-byte dependency keys force byte-limited windows; a SQL file_path value exceeding64KiB keeps3 legal rows as3 single-row statements rather than rejecting them.

new_controls.name: snapshot_dependency_manifest_and_rows_match_original_full_writer
new_controls.coverage: Use real rebuild_with_temp_db original per-file writer versus SnapshotWriteTxn on0/1/7/8/9/63/64/65/73 files; compare dependency rowids/order, manifest payload/digest, public surfaces and normalized duplicate records; generation increments and subsequent live incremental replacement preserved.

new_controls.name: snapshot_dependency_failure_keeps_live_rows_and_generation_like_original
new_controls.coverage: Real temp/WAL rebuild: fail dependency key70 after earlier file and earlier windows; separately version999 validation failure. Compare original/new returned errors and unchanged live generation, files and full dependency/manifest/surface rows.

error_boundary.committed_state: The production rebuild callback propagates failure; execute_temp_db_staging_build retains its existing transaction drop/cleanup before swap. No partial dependency or manifest is accepted.
error_boundary.unfinished_statement_prefix: A failing multi-row statement can have a different uncommitted intra-statement prefix from separate INSERTs before the enclosing transaction is discarded. The candidate does not claim these prefixes are equal or authorize ignoring an error and committing.
error_boundary.direct_writer: No claim of physical rollback under journal_mode=OFF; its existing failure propagation/staging lifecycle are not changed. The new failure tests exercise the existing WAL/temp transaction seam.
error_boundary.validation_failure: No validation or payload rejection was moved after the original DELETE or manifest write.

evidence_and_performance_boundary.interpretation: This original cold resolution_dependencies row count motivates inspection only; no per-table timing proves this table is the slowest or predicts any speedup.
